TwitchGetRewards.description: Lists every channel point reward of your channel, with title, cost, prompt, colour and whether it is on or paused. IsOurs tells you if Cuebot created it (only those can be changed).
TwitchGetRewards.returns: A list of rewards. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).
TwitchGetRewards.example:
var rewards = CPH.TwitchGetRewards();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {rewards.Count} rewards");

EnableReward.description: Turns a channel point reward on, so viewers can see it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.
EnableReward.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

DisableReward.description: Turns a channel point reward off, so viewers no longer see it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.
DisableReward.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

PauseReward.description: Pauses a channel point reward. Viewers still see it but cannot redeem it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.
PauseReward.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

UnPauseReward.description: Unpauses a channel point reward, so viewers can redeem it again. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.
UnPauseReward.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

UpdateRewardMaxPerStream.description: Sets how many times a reward can be redeemed in one stream, by everyone together. 0 means no limit. With additive true, it adds to the current limit. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.
UpdateRewardMaxPerStream.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

UpdateRewardMaxPerUserPerStream.description: Sets how many times each viewer can redeem a reward in one stream. 0 means no limit. With additive true, it adds to the current limit. Only works for rewards Cuebot created.
UpdateRewardMaxPerUserPerStream.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

TwitchRedemptionFulfill.description: Marks a viewer's redemption as done, so it leaves the reward queue. You need both the reward id and the redemption id (the %rewardId% and %redemptionId% of a reward trigger).
TwitchRedemptionFulfill.returns: true when it worked. False when an id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchRedemptionCancel.description: Cancels a viewer's redemption and gives them their channel points back. You need both the reward id and the redemption id.
TwitchRedemptionCancel.returns: true when it worked. False when an id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchGetRewardCounter.description: Reads how many times a reward has been redeemed, as Cuebot counts it. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action. Resetting on go-live is set per reward on the Twitch page, so persisted is ignored.
TwitchGetRewardCounter.returns: The counter (Count is the number), or null when the reward was not found.
TwitchGetRewardCounter.example:
var counter = CPH.TwitchGetRewardCounter("Hydrate");
CPH.LogInfo($"Hydrate used {counter?.Count} times");

TwitchGetRewardUserCounter.description: Reads how many times one viewer (by login name) has redeemed a reward. persisted is ignored.
TwitchGetRewardUserCounter.returns: The counter (Count is the number), or null when the reward or viewer was not found.
TwitchGetRewardUserCounter.example:
var counter = CPH.TwitchGetRewardUserCounter("coolviewer", "Hydrate");
CPH.LogInfo($"coolviewer used it {counter?.Count} times");

TwitchGetRewardUserCounterById.description: Reads how many times one viewer (by Twitch user id) has redeemed a reward. persisted is ignored.
TwitchGetRewardUserCounterById.returns: The counter (Count is the number), or null when the id is empty or the reward or viewer was not found.

TwitchGetRewardUserCounters.description: Lists every viewer's redemption count for one reward. Handy for a "top redeemers" message. persisted is ignored.
TwitchGetRewardUserCounters.returns: A list with one counter per viewer (user id, name and count). Empty when the reward was not found.

TwitchResetRewardCounter.description: Sets a reward's total redemption count back to 0. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action.
TwitchResetRewardCounter.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

TwitchResetRewardUserCounters.description: Clears every viewer's redemption count for one reward. rewardId is the reward's id or title; empty means the reward that ran this action.
TwitchResetRewardUserCounters.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

TwitchResetUserRewardCounter.description: Clears one viewer's (by Twitch user id) redemption count for one reward.
TwitchResetUserRewardCounter.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

TwitchResetUserRewardCounters.description: Clears one viewer's (by Twitch user id) redemption counts for every reward. persisted is ignored, but you must still pass it.
TwitchResetUserRewardCounters.returns: Nothing. If it fails, a warning goes to the log.

TwitchReplyToMessage.description: Replies to one chat message, so it shows as a reply. replyId is the message's id (%messageId%). useBot sends with your bot; fallback uses your main account when the bot is not signed in.
TwitchReplyToMessage.returns: true when Twitch accepted it. False when the message is empty or Twitch said no.
TwitchReplyToMessage.example:
bool ok = CPH.TwitchReplyToMessage("Good question!", args["messageId"].ToString());
CPH.LogInfo($"Replied: {ok}");

TwitchDeleteChatMessage.description: Deletes one chat message by its id. Your main account deletes it; bot is ignored.
TwitchDeleteChatMessage.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchClearChatMessages.description: Clears your whole Twitch chat. Your main account does it; bot is ignored.
TwitchClearChatMessages.returns: true when it worked. When Twitch refuses or is not signed in, it gives back false and writes a warning to the log.

TwitchPinChatMessage.description: Pins a chat message (by its id) at the top of chat. duration is in seconds (30 to 1800); 0 keeps it pinned until the stream ends. bot is ignored.
TwitchPinChatMessage.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchSendAndPinMessage.description: Sends a message from your main account and pins it right away. duration works like TwitchPinChatMessage (0 keeps it until the stream ends). bot is ignored.
TwitchSendAndPinMessage.returns: true when it worked. False when the message is empty or Twitch said no.
TwitchSendAndPinMessage.example:
bool ok = CPH.TwitchSendAndPinMessage("Giveaway: type !join to enter!", 300);
CPH.LogInfo($"Sent and pinned: {ok}");

TwitchUnpinMessage.description: Unpins the chat message that is pinned now.
TwitchUnpinMessage.returns: true when it worked. False when nothing is pinned or Twitch said no.

TwitchUpdatePinnedMessageDuration.description: Changes how long the pinned message stays, counted from now, in seconds. 0 keeps it pinned until the stream ends.
TwitchUpdatePinnedMessageDuration.returns: true when it worked. False when nothing is pinned or Twitch said no.

TwitchGetPinnedMessage.description: Reads the chat message that is pinned now: its text, who wrote it, who pinned it, and when the pin started and ends.
TwitchGetPinnedMessage.returns: The pinned message, or null when nothing is pinned or the check failed.
TwitchGetPinnedMessage.example:
var pin = CPH.TwitchGetPinnedMessage();
CPH.LogInfo(pin == null ? "Nothing pinned" : $"Pinned: {pin.Message}");

TwitchWarnUser.description: Sends a viewer (by login name) a Twitch warning with your reason. They must accept it before they can chat again. useBot is ignored.
TwitchWarnUser.returns: true when it worked. False when the name is empty or Twitch said no.
TwitchWarnUser.example:
bool ok = CPH.TwitchWarnUser("rudeviewer", "Please keep chat friendly.");
CPH.LogInfo($"Warned: {ok}");

TwitchAddActiveMonitoringSuspiciousStatu.description: Puts a viewer (by Twitch user id) under active monitoring. Their messages get flagged for your moderators.
TwitchAddActiveMonitoringSuspiciousStatu.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchAddRestrictedSuspiciousStatus.description: Restricts a viewer (by Twitch user id). Their messages are kept out of chat; only moderators see them.
TwitchAddRestrictedSuspiciousStatus.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchRemoveSuspiciousStatus.description: Removes the monitored or restricted status from a viewer (by Twitch user id).
TwitchRemoveSuspiciousStatus.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchAddBlockedTerm.description: Adds a word or phrase to your channel's blocked terms. Messages with it are kept out of chat.
TwitchAddBlockedTerm.returns: true when it worked. False when the term is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchRemoveBlockedTerm.description: Removes a word or phrase from your blocked terms. Type it as it was added; upper and lower case do not matter.
TwitchRemoveBlockedTerm.returns: true when it was removed. False when your channel has no such term, the term is empty, or Twitch said no.

TwitchGetBlockedTerms.description: Lists every blocked word or phrase of your channel.
TwitchGetBlockedTerms.returns: A list of texts. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).

TwitchApproveAutoHeldMessage.description: Lets a message through that AutoMod held back for review. Pass the held message's id.
TwitchApproveAutoHeldMessage.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchDenyAutoHeldMessage.description: Blocks a message that AutoMod held back for review, so it never shows in chat.
TwitchDenyAutoHeldMessage.returns: true when it worked. False when the id is empty or Twitch said no.

TwitchGetMods.description: Lists every moderator of your channel, with their id, login name and display name.
TwitchGetMods.returns: A list of users. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).
TwitchGetMods.example:
var mods = CPH.TwitchGetMods();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {mods.Count} mods");

TwitchGetVips.description: Lists every VIP of your channel, with their id, login name and display name.
TwitchGetVips.returns: A list of users. Empty when Twitch said no (a warning goes to the log).
TwitchGetVips.example:
var vips = CPH.TwitchGetVips();
CPH.LogInfo($"VIPs: {string.Join(", ", vips.Select(v => v.UserName))}");

GetCheermotes.description: Lists the cheermotes (Bits emotes like Cheer100) your channel can use, with their tiers, colours and image links.
GetCheermotes.returns: A list of cheermotes. Empty when Twitch said no.

TwitchBlockUser.description: Blocks someone for your Twitch account, so they cannot whisper you or show up in your chat. userLogin is their login name. The context and reason are not sent to Twitch. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).
TwitchBlockUser.returns: true when Twitch blocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

TwitchBlockUserById.description: Like TwitchBlockUser, with the person's Twitch user id. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).
TwitchBlockUserById.returns: true when Twitch blocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

GetAllClips.description: Lists the clips of your own channel. Clips come most viewed first, at most 1000. isFeatured true gives only featured clips, false only the others, and leaving it out gives both.
GetAllClips.returns: A list of clips (link, title, views, creator and more). Empty when Twitch said no.
GetAllClips.example:
var clips = CPH.GetAllClips();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {clips.Count} clips");

GetClips.description: Lists your own channel's most viewed clips, up to count clips (at least 1). isFeatured true gives only featured clips, false only the others.
GetClips.returns: A list of clips. Empty when Twitch said no.

GetClipsForGame.description: Lists clips of one game or category from all of Twitch, using the game's Twitch id. Other versions add how many clips, a start and end time, or a time span back from now (like the last 7 days).
GetClipsForGame.returns: A list of clips, most viewed first. Empty when Twitch said no.
GetClipsForGame.example:
var clips = CPH.GetClipsForGame(509658, TimeSpan.FromDays(7), 5);
CPH.LogInfo($"Top clip this week: {clips.FirstOrDefault()?.Title}");

GetClipsForUser.description: Lists clips of another channel, by login name or by user id as a number. Other versions add how many clips, a start and end time, or a time span back from now. Great for a shoutout that plays a clip.
GetClipsForUser.returns: A list of clips, most viewed first. Empty when the name is empty or Twitch said no.
GetClipsForUser.example:
var clips = CPH.GetClipsForUser("coolstreamer", 1);
CPH.LogInfo($"Their top clip: {clips.FirstOrDefault()?.Url}");

GetClipsForUserById.description: Lists clips of another channel by its Twitch user id (as text). Other versions add how many clips, a start and end time, or a time span back from now.
GetClipsForUserById.returns: A list of clips, most viewed first. Empty when the id is empty or Twitch said no.
GetClipsForUserById.example:
var clips = CPH.GetClipsForUserById("12345678", TimeSpan.FromDays(30), 3);
CPH.LogInfo($"Found {clips.Count} clips");

TwitchUnblockUser.description: Unblocks someone you blocked before. userLogin is their login name. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).
TwitchUnblockUser.returns: true when Twitch unblocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).

TwitchUnblockUserById.description: Like TwitchUnblockUser, with the person's Twitch user id. Needs the "Block and unblock users" permission on the Twitch Settings tab (sign in again after ticking it).
TwitchUnblockUserById.returns: true when Twitch unblocked them; false otherwise (a warning goes to the log).
